speech.heard: The USA has 7.1 times the liquid assets Angola has relative to its economy. In Angola, this pool of exchange tools is just 14%. It counts instruments widely accepted for exchange, plus those converted to cash at short notice. Nigeria has 29% and Pakistan has 41%. Climb continues. Indonesia has 43%, Mexico has 48%, and Russia has 70%. India is higher at 82%. The USA is one of the highest at 99.7%, nearly equal to its entire annual income. How much liquid money circulates in your economy?
differences: base.en: 'the climb' heard as 'time' after 'pakistan has 41%'
